title: Musk Demonstrates Live: Grok's New Feature Can Watch Videos, A Kobe AI Video Accurately Reveals the Truth
excerpt: When Musk promoted the new version of his AI platform Grok on a social media platform, he uploaded an AI-generated video of the late basketball legend Kobe Brya
content_html:
When Musk promoted the new version of his AI platform Grok on a social media platform, he uploaded an AI-generated video of the late basketball legend Kobe Bryant as a test case. Grok not only fully analyzed the visuals and scenes but also accurately extracted the key dialogue, ultimately determining the video to be a deepfake AI-generated content—showcasing new video interaction capabilities.

From the chat logs released by Musk, it can be seen that Grok first analyzed the footage frame by frame: "Kobe was wearing a black suit, delivering a monologue with his signature 'Mamba spirit,' accompanied by pointing, gestures, smiling, and leaning forward towards the camera, with lighting that had a cinematic quality." The model then accurately extracted key dialogues from the video such as "The strongest intelligent model SpaceX has ever built," "Grok 4.5, greatness comes from perseverance, Mamba, exit," among others.

Comprehensive determination as Deepfake, the AI video of Kobe is exposed

The most critical part was the comprehensive judgment—Grok combined all visual elements, dialogue, and contextual information to finally determine that this footage was a deepfake AI-generated video, and pointed out that Kobe had passed away in 2020, and all the images of the person in the video were generated by AI rather than real footage. This means that Grok not only can "understand" video content, but also has the reasoning ability to distinguish authenticity.

From audio summaries to full-dimensional understanding, video interaction achieves a generation leap

The video interaction feature newly launched by Grok allows users to directly upload local video files or paste links in the conversation window, giving various instructions to the AI. Supported functions include summarizing the entire video, identifying people and objects in the visuals, breaking down action details, or continuously asking questions about any specific detail.

Compared to the previous mode of only extracting audio text to generate summaries, the new Grok has achieved a significant upgrade—capable of linking continuous frames, audio information, and contextual logic to comprehensively and deeply understand the entire video content. When AI evolves from "listening to videos" to "watching videos," and from content summarization to authenticity verification, the ceiling of video interaction has been raised once again.

content_html_zh:
当马斯克在社交媒体平台上推广其人工智能平台Grok的新版本时，他上传了一段由人工智能生成的已故篮球传奇人物科比·布莱恩特的视频作为测试用例。 Grok 不仅全面分析了视觉效果和场景，还准确提取了关键对话，最终确定该视频为 Deepfake 人工智能生成的内容，展示了新的视频交互能力。

从马斯克公布的聊天记录中可以看出，格罗克首先对这段镜头进行了逐帧分析：“科比身穿黑色西装，以他标志性的‘曼巴精神’进行独白，伴随着指点、手势、微笑、前倾镜头，灯光具有电影般的质感。” 然后，该模型准确地从视频中提取出“SpaceX 有史以来最强的智能模型”、“Grok 4.5，伟大源于坚持、曼巴、退出”等关键对话。

综合判定为Deepfake，科比AI视频曝光

最关键的部分是综合判断——Grok结合了所有视觉元素、对话和上下文信息，最终确定这段视频是一个deepfake人工智能生成的视频，并指出科比已于2020年去世，视频中人的所有图像都是人工智能生成的而不是真实的镜头。 这意味着Grok不仅可以“理解”视频内容，还具备辨别真伪的推理能力。

从音频概括到全维度理解，视频交互实现代际跨越

Grok新推出的视频交互功能允许用户直接上传本地视频文件或在对话窗口中粘贴链接，向AI发出各种指令。 支持的功能包括总结整个视频、识别视觉效果中的人物和物体、分解动作细节或不断询问有关任何特定细节的问题。

与之前仅提取音频文本生成摘要的模式相比，新的 Grok 实现了重大升级——能够链接连续帧、音频信息和上下文逻辑，全面、深入地理解整个视频内容。 当人工智能从“听视频”进化到“看视频”，从内容概括进化到真伪验证，视频交互的天花板再次被抬高。
